rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The interrogative من asks who owns all in the heavens and earth; ما is relative, nominative as subject, with لمن as its predicate.
rows.anchor: من استفهام وما بمعنى الذى فى موضع الرفع على الابتداء ولمن خبره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The answer means that all belongs to God; neither interlocutor can dispute this or attribute any part of it to another.
rows.anchor: تقدير لهم أى هو لله لاخلاف بينى وبينكم ولا تقدرون أن تضيفوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although كتب basically means making obligatory, it cannot mean God owes a duty to a servant; it means an emphatic promise God will certainly fulfill.
rows.anchor: أصل كتب أوجب ولكن لا يجوز الاجراء على ظاهره إذ لا يجب على الله شيء للعبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reference to God's self marks His exclusive undertaking and removes intermediaries.
rows.anchor: وذكر النفس للاختصاص ورفع الوسائط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gathering is a threat for neglecting reflection and associating God with one unable to create; لا ريب فيه may refer either to the Day or the gathering.
rows.anchor: ثم أو عدهم على اغفالهم النظر واشراكهم به من لا يقدر على خلق شيء بقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: الذين خسروا أنفسهم is accusative as a censure, referring to those who chose disbelief and thus ruined themselves.
rows.anchor: نصب على الذم أى أريد الذين خسروا أنفسهم باختيارهم الكفر

rows.speaker: الأخفش
rows.claim: Al-Akhfash parses الذين as an appositive to the second-person pronoun in ليجمعنكم, identifying the gathered people as the idolaters who lost themselves.
rows.anchor: وقال الأخفش الذين بدل من كم فى ليجمعنكم أى ليجمعن من هؤلاء المشركين الذين خسروا أنفسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author prefers the censure parsing: following Sibawayh, an obvious pronoun such as ي or ك does not need an appositive.
rows.anchor: والوجه هو الأول لأن سيبويه قال لا يجوز مررت بى المسكين ولا بك المسكين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Messengers is an omitted object after “We sent”; the communities denied those messengers.
rows.anchor: رسلا فالمفعول محذوف فكذبوهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: البأساء means hardship such as drought and hunger, while الضراء means illness and loss of lives and property.
rows.anchor: بالبؤس والضر والأول القحط والجوع والثانى المرض ونقصان الأنفس والأموال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trials aim to make people humble and contrite before their Lord and repent; souls become submissive when hardships descend.
rows.anchor: يتذللون ويتخشعون لربهم ويتوبون عن ذنوبهم فالنفوس تتخشع عند نزول الشدائد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rhetorical question means, “Why did they not repent and humble themselves?” In fact, they did not supplicate when the punishment came.
rows.anchor: أى هلا تضرعوا بالتوبة ومعناه نفى التضرع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording with لولا indicates that obstinacy was their only excuse for failing to humble themselves.
rows.anchor: ولكنه جاء بلولا ليفيد أنه لم يكن لهم عذر فى ترك التضرع إلا عنادا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their hearts hardened, so they did not learn from what afflicted them.
rows.anchor: فلم يتزوجوا بما ابتلوا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan made their deeds seem attractive, and they became pleased with those deeds.
rows.anchor: وصاروا معجبين بأعمالهم التى زينها الشيطان لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They forgot the warning by refusing to take admonition from hardship and by not being restrained by it.
rows.anchor: من البأساء والضراء أى تركوا الاتعاظ به ولم يزجرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opened doors of every kind of good mean health, abundance, and varieties of blessing.
rows.anchor: من الصحة والسعة وصنوف النعمة

rows.speaker: الشامي
rows.claim: The Shami reader is associated with the reading فتحنا at the phrase about opening the doors.
rows.anchor: من الصحة والسعة وصنوف النعمة فتحنا شامى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They rejoiced in the good and blessings they had received; when seized suddenly, they were despairing and regretful, literally bowed down in grief or regret.
rows.anchor: آيسون متحسرون وأصله الاطراق حزنا لما أصابه أو ندما على ما فاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إذا here marks suddenness.
rows.anchor: لما أصابه أو ندما على ما فاته و إذا للمفاجأة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The unjust people were destroyed to the last, with no one left among them.
rows.anchor: أى أهلكوا عن آخرهم ولم يترك منهم أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse signals that praise is due to God when oppressors perish: this is among the greatest blessings, or people are told to praise Him for destroying those who did not praise Him.
rows.anchor: إيذان بوجوب الحمد لله عند هلاك الظلمة و أنه من أجل النعم واجزل القسم أو احمدوا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address is directed to Abu Bakr to say to his son Abd al-Rahman, who was inviting his father to worship idols.
rows.anchor: لابى بكر يقل لابنه عبد الرحمن وكان يدعوا اباه إلى عبادة الأوثان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question means, “Should we worship besides God what cannot benefit us if invoked or harm us if left alone?”
rows.anchor: مالايقدر على نفعنا أن دعوناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An alternative reading is ونرد, “and we are returned,” rather than ونرد, “and we return.”
rows.anchor: ونرد ﴾ وأنرد ﴿ على أعقابنا ﴾ راجعين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning back on their heels means returning to associationism after God guided them to Islam and rescued them from idol worship.
rows.anchor: راجعين إلى الشرك ﴿ بعد إذ هدانا الله ﴾ للاسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The simile likens the backslider to someone whom devils have lured away, like a man taken off by ghūls and rebellious jinn; the ك is circumstantial from the pronoun in نرد.
rows.anchor: كالذى ذهبت به الغيلان ومردة الجن والكاف فى محل النصب على الحال من الضمير فى نرد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: استهوته is an intensive form from wandering aimlessly through the earth; the wilderness is meant, and حيران describes the lured person as lost and unsure what to do.
rows.anchor: وهو استفعال من هوى فى الأرض إذا ذهب فيها كان معناه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: له refers to the lured person and أصحاب means his companions; they call him to guidance by showing him the road, and the straight road is called guidance.
rows.anchor: إلى أن يهدوه الطريق سمى الطريق المستقيم بالهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They call “Come to us,” but the man has taken an aimless route after the jinn and ignores them; this follows the belief that jinn lure people and ghūls seize them, like a Muslim astray from Islam who ignores Muslim callers.
rows.anchor: وهذا مبنى على ما يقال أن الجن تستهوى الانسان والغيلان تستولى عليه فشبه به الضال عن طريق الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's guidance means Islam, the sole true guidance; everything beyond it is error.
rows.anchor: ﴿ هو الهدى ﴾ وحده وما وراءه ضلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: وأمرنا is accusative by coordination with the syntactic position of إن هدى الله هو الهدى, as though two statements were commanded: say this, and say that we were commanded.
rows.anchor: محله النصب بالعطف على محل إن هدى الله هو الهدى على أنهما مقولان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: جنّ الليل means the night became dark; the clause is coordinated with Abraham's earlier statement to his father, while “Thus We showed Abraham” is parenthetical.
rows.anchor: أى أظلم وهو عطف على قال إبراهيم لأبيه وقوله وكذلك نرى إبراهيم جملة اعتراضية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The star Abraham saw was either Venus or Jupiter.
rows.anchor: ﴿ رأى كوكبا ﴾ أى الزهرة أو المشترى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because Abraham's people worshipped idols, sun, moon, and stars, he meant to expose their error and lead them to reason that these originated, changing bodies have a maker who directs their rising, setting, movement, and other states.
rows.anchor: فأراد أن ينبههم على الخطأ فى دينهم و أن يرشدهم إلى طريق النظر والاستدلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “This is my lord” can mean “this is your lord, as you claim,” or be a mocking rhetorical question; Arabs can signal a question by vocal tone without an interrogative particle.
rows.anchor: أى قال لهم هذا ربى فى زعمكم أو المراد أهذا استهزاء بهم وانكارا عليهم والعرب تكتفى عن حرف الاستفهام بنغمة الصوت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author prefers Abraham's fair-minded rehearsal of an opponent's claim: it is less partisan, better leads to truth and avoids dispute, before he refutes it with proof.
rows.anchor: والصحيح أن هذا قول من ينصف خصمه مع علمه أنه مبطل فيحكى قوله كما هو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أفل means the star disappeared; Abraham rejects worship of gods that change from one state to another, since change characterizes bodies.
rows.anchor: أى لا أحب عبادة الأرباب المتغيرين عن حال إلى حال لأن ذلك من صفات الأجسام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: بازغا means beginning to rise.
rows.anchor: مبتدئا فى الطلوع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By saying this to his people, Abraham points out that whoever takes the moon as a god is astray.
rows.anchor: نبه قومه على أن من اتخذ القمر إلها فهو ضال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He argues from setting rather than rising, although both are changes of state, because setting is a clearer transition through concealment and disappearance.
rows.anchor: و إنما احتج عليهم بالأفول دون البزوع وكلاهما انتقال من حال إلى حال لأن الاحتجاج به أظهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The masculine هذا with the sun is justified because it can refer to the rising object, or because subject and predicate are one in meaning; this also avoids attributing feminine form to God, as in علام rather than علامة.
rows.anchor: وامنا ذكره لأنه أراد الطالع أو لأنه جعل المبتدا مثل الخبر لانهما شيء واحد معنى وفيه صيانة الرب عن شبهة التأنيث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: هذا أكبر uses the masculine adjective as well, in speaking to Abraham's opponents.
rows.anchor: من باب استعمال الصفة أيضا مع خصومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He declares himself free of the celestial bodies that the people make partners of their Creator.
rows.anchor: شركاء لخالقها وقيل هذا كان نظره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One view says Abraham's observation and reasoning occurred privately within himself and God related it.
rows.anchor: وقيل هذا كان نظره واستدلاله فى نفسه فحكاه الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The author prefers that Abraham said this publicly to his people, as indicated by his address, “My people, I am free of what you associate.”
rows.anchor: والأول اظهر لقوله يا قوم إنى برئ مما تشركون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The created heavens and earth are evidence that their Creator brought them into being.
rows.anchor: أي للذى دلت هذه المحدثات على أنه منشئها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حنيفا describes turning away from all religions except Islam.
rows.anchor: حال أى مائلا عن الأديان كلها إلا هذا الإسلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham disavows associating any created thing with God.
rows.anchor: ﴿ وما أنا من المشركين ﴾ بالله شيئا من خلقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: آبائهم is accusative, coordinated with كلا: God favored some of the prophets' fathers too, as well as their descendants and brothers, and chose and guided them.
rows.anchor: فى موضع النصب عطفا على كلا أى وفضلنا بعض آبائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Those” refers to the prophets mentioned earlier.
rows.anchor: أى الأنبياء الذين مر ذكرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fronted object means that Muhammad should follow their guidance exclusively; this is their way of believing in and unifying God and the fundamentals of religion, not their differing legal codes.
rows.anchor: فاختص هداهم بالاقتداء ولا تقتد إلا بهم وهذا معنى تقديم المفعول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ه in اقتده marks pause and drops in connected speech; pausing is preferred because the muṣḥaf retains it.
rows.anchor: والهاء فى اقتده للوقف تسقط فى الوصل واستحسن إيثار الوقف لثبات الهاء فى المصحف

rows.speaker: حمزة وعلي
rows.claim: Hamza and Ali omit the ه in connected recitation.
rows.anchor: وبحذفها حمزة وعلى فى الوصل

rows.speaker: الشامي
rows.claim: The Shami reader pronounces the ه with partial vowel articulation in connected speech.
rows.anchor: ويختلسها شامى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The payment Muhammad refuses is for revelation or conveying the message and calling people to God's unity; the verse supports forbidding payment for teaching the Qur'an or narrating hadith.
rows.anchor: جعلا وفيه دليلا على أن اخذ الأجر على تعليم القرآن ورواية الحديث لا يجوز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Qur'an is an admonition for all people, jinn and humans.
rows.anchor: ما القرآن إلا عظة للجن والانس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The instruction follows the rejection of those who mislead by permitting the forbidden and forbidding the lawful.
rows.anchor: هو مسبب على انكار اتباع المضلين الذين يحلون الحرام ويحرمون الحلال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Opponents argued that if Muslims worship God, what God killed (carrion) should be more worthy to eat than what they slaughter; the response permits only meat slaughtered with God's name, excluding dedication to another deity and animals that die naturally.
rows.anchor: فما قتل الله أحق أن تأكلوا مما قتلتم أنتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition concerns an animal over which God's name was not mentioned at slaughter; eating it is transgression.
rows.anchor: عند الذبح ﴿ وإنه ﴾ و إن اكله ﴿ لفسق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan whispers to its allies among the polytheists to argue that Muslims reject what God killed but eat what they slaughter themselves.
rows.anchor: ﴿ ليجادلوكم ﴾ بقولهم لا تأكلون مما قتله الله وتأكلون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse prohibits meat left without the invocation; a hadith exempts forgetfulness, or the forgetful person may be treated as having invoked God's name implicitly.
rows.anchor: و الآية تحرم متروك التسمية وخصت حالة النسيان بالحديث أو يجعل الناسي ذاكرا تقديرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Obeying them by declaring God's prohibition lawful is associationism, since taking a religion from other than God is associating a partner with Him; the severe warning calls for abstaining from meat without the invocation.
rows.anchor: لأن من اتبع غير الله دينه فقد أشرك به ومن حق المتدين

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: Some interpret the verse as referring to carrion and meat over which another than God was named, citing the phrase “or a sinful one over which another than God was invoked.”
rows.anchor: ومن أول الآية بالميتة وبما ذكر غير اسم الله عليه لقوله أو فسقا أهل لغير الله به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes the wāw in وإنه لفسق as circumstantial because a nominal clause does not coordinate well with a verbal one; the omitted sense is not to eat it while it is dedicated to another than God.
rows.anchor: وقال أن الواو فى وانه لفسق للحال لأن عطف الجملة الاسمية على الفعلية لا يحسن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: On that interpretation, other meat remains lawful under general permissions, including the verse “Say: I find no …”; but it departs from the apparent wording.
rows.anchor: فيكون ما سواه حلالا بالعمومات المحلة منها قوله قل لا أجد الآية فقد عدل عن ظاهر اللفظ

rows.speaker: أبو عمرو ومدني
rows.claim: Abu Amr and the Medinan readers read the possessive form “my Lord” as annotated at ربى.
rows.anchor: ربى أبو عمرو ومدنى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: دينا is accusative as a بدل from the syntactic position of إلى صراط مستقيم, which means “He guided me to a path,” as in 4:68.
rows.anchor: نصب على البدل من محل إلى صراط مستقيم لأن معناه هدانى صراطا بدليل قوله

rows.speaker: كوفي وشامي
rows.claim: Kufan and Shami readers use قيما, a verbal noun meaning standing, as an adjective; the other form is more emphatic than قائم.
rows.anchor: قيما كوفى وشامى وهو مصدر بمعنى القيام وصف به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ملة إبراهيم is an explanatory apposition, حنيفا is a circumstantial phrase referring to Abraham, and the denial of association is addressed to Quraysh.
rows.anchor: عطف بيان ﴿ حنيفا ﴾ حال من إبراهيم ﴿ وما كان من المشركين ﴾ بالله يا معشر قريش

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أغويتني means “You led me astray”; the bāʾ belongs to an omitted oath, so the sense is “because You misled me, I swear.”
rows.anchor: أضللتني أي فبسسبب اغوائك اياى والباء تتعلق بعفل القسم المحذوف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis will waylay people on Islam's straight path, standing across it to block travelers like an enemy obstructing a road; the phrase is adverbial.
rows.anchor: لأعترضن لهم على طريق الإسلام متردصا للرد متعرضا للصد كما يتعرض العدو على الطريق

rows.speaker: طاوس
rows.claim: Ta'us answered a Qadari in the Sacred Mosque, “Stand up or be stood up”; when challenged, he said Iblis knew better because Iblis blamed God for misguiding him, while the man said he misguides himself.
rows.anchor: وعن طاوس أنه كان فى المسجد الحرام فجاء رجل قدرى فقال له طاوس تقوم أوتقام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The particle أن is explanatory, and the request for drink indicates that Paradise is above Hell.
rows.anchor: أن مفسرة وفيه دليل على أن الجنة فوق النار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “Or from what God provided” may mean other drinks, which fall under pouring, or it may request food such as fruit, by an idiom that names straw and cold water for feeding and watering.
rows.anchor: من غيره من الاشربة لدخوله فى حكم الافاضة أو اريد أو ألقوا علينا مما رزقكم الله من الطعام والفاكهة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They ask despite expecting refusal because a desperate person says anything that might be useful, even what is not.
rows.anchor: و إنما سألوا ذلك مع بأسهم عن الاجابة لأن المتحري ينطق بما يفيد وبما لا يفيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: حرمهما means God deprived them of the two things, as in His preventing nursing women for Moses.
rows.anchor: هو تحريم منع كما فى وحرمن عليه المراضع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pause after على الكافرين if the following الذين is accusative as censure; do not pause if it is genitive as an adjective modifying الكافرين.
rows.anchor: وتقف هنا أن رفعت أو نصبت ما بعده ذما وإن جررته وصفا للكافرين فلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They made religion frivolous by declaring lawful and forbidden whatever they wished, or made their festival their habitual amusement.
rows.anchor: فحرموا وأحلوا ماشاءوا أوديتهم عيدهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They were deceived by worldly life, imagining they would remain in it for a long time.
rows.anchor: اغتروا بطول البقاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “We forget them” means We leave them in punishment.
rows.anchor: كما نسوا لقاء يومهم هذا وما كانوا بآياتنا يجحدون ﴾ أى كنسيانهم وجحودهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God treats them in keeping with their forgetting the meeting of this Day and their denial of His signs.
rows.anchor: أى كنسيانهم وجحودهم

rows.speaker: مكي وحمزة وعلى
rows.claim: Makki, Hamza, and Ali read the singular الريح instead of plural الرياح.
rows.anchor: الريح مكى وحمززة وعلى

rows.speaker: حمزة وعلى
rows.claim: Hamza and Ali read بُشْراً as the verbal noun نشروا, governed by أرسل or treated as a circumstantial phrase meaning “spread.”
rows.anchor: حمزة وعلى مصدر نشروا انتصابه إما لأن أرسل ونشوء متقاربان فكأنه قيل نشرها نشرا

rows.speaker: عاصم
rows.claim: Asim lightens the reading بشرا, treating it as the plural of بشير because the winds announce rain.
rows.anchor: عاصم تخفيف بشرا تجمع بشير لأن الرياح تبشر بالمطر

rows.speaker: شامي
rows.claim: The Shami reader lightens نشرًا like the two forms of رسل; the other readers take it as the plural of نشور, winds spreading rain.
rows.anchor: شامى تخفيف نشر كرسل ورسل وهو قراءة الباقين جمع نشور أى ناشرة للمطر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before God's mercy means before His bounty, namely rain, one of the greatest blessings.
rows.anchor: امام نعمته وهو الغيث الذى هو من أجل النعم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أقلت means the wind-borne clouds carried and raised the water; the derivation relates to قليل, since a lifter regards its burden as small.
rows.anchor: تحملت ورفعت واشتقاق الافلال من القلة لأن الرافع المطيق برى ما يرفعه قليلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Heavy clouds are loaded with water, and سحاب is the plural/collective of سحابة.
rows.anchor: بالماء جمع سحابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun in سقناه follows the masculine word form سحاب; following its meaning as a plural would call for feminine agreement, as it would with the adjective ثقيل.
rows.anchor: لانث كما لو حمل الوصف على اللفظ لقيل ثقيلا

rows.speaker: مدني وحمزة وعلى وحفص
rows.claim: The Medinan readers, Hamza, Ali, and Hafs read بلد ميت; the phrase refers to land without rain, brought rain for watering it.
rows.anchor: لأجل بلد ليس فيه مطر ولسقيه ميت مدنى وحمزة وعلى وحفص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pronoun in أنزلنا به may refer to the cloud or to the driving of the cloud; by the same means fruit is produced.
rows.anchor: بالسحاب أو بالسوق وكذلك ﴿ فأخرجنا به من كل الثمرات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Just as God brings out fruits, He brings out the dead; both are renewed after being brought into existence, so reflection leads to belief in resurrection.
rows.anchor: إذ لا فرق بين الاخراجين لأن كل واحد منهما إعادة الشئ بعد إنشائه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The land is Egypt, and Moses' corruption means dominating it and changing its people's religion; this had happened when he led six hundred thousand magicians to faith.
rows.anchor: ارض مصر بالاستعلاء فيها وتغيير دين أهلها لأنه والق السحرة على الإيمان ستمائة ألف نفر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ويذرك is coordinated with ليفسدوا; before this, Pharaoh had made idols for his people and ordered worship of them as a means of drawing near to him, like idolaters who say idols bring them near to God.
rows.anchor: عطف على لفسدوا قبل صنع فرعون لقومه أصناما وأمرهم أن يعبدوها تقربا إليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This explains Pharaoh's claim, “I am your Lord, the highest.”
rows.anchor: ولذلك قال انا ربكم الأعاى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh says they will resume killing their sons to show they remain dominant, reassure the public, and prevent the astrologers' prophecy about Moses from discouraging obedience and drawing people to him.
rows.anchor: سنقتل حجازى أى سنعيد عليهم قتل الأبناء ليعلموا انا على ما كنا عليه من الغلبة والقهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses counseled this when the people panicked at Pharaoh's threat, to console them and promise victory.
rows.anchor: قال لهم ذلك حين جزعوا من قول فرعون سنقتل أبناءهم تسلية لهم ووعدا بالنصر عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The definite article in الأرض may refer specifically to Egypt, or generically to the earth, with Egypt included foremost.
rows.anchor: راللام للعهد أى ارض مصر أو للجنس فيتناول ارص مصر تناولا أوليا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God grants the land to whichever servants He wills; this gives the Israelites hope of inheriting Egypt.
rows.anchor: فيه تمنيته إياهم أرض مصر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: “The outcome belongs to the God-fearing” promises a good end for the God-fearing among both the Israelites and the Copts.
rows.anchor: بشارة بأن الخاتمة المحمدودة للمتقين منهم ومن القبط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This clause begins without waw because it is a new sentence, unlike the preceding report of the chiefs, which is coordinated with what came before.
rows.anchor: وأخليت هذه الجملة عن الواو لانها جملة مستأنفة بخلاف قوله وقال الملأ لانها معطوفة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses returned from the mountain to the Israelites angry and grieved; غضبان and أسفا are both circumstantial phrases.
rows.anchor: حال من مسوى ﴿ أسفا ﴾ حال أيضا أى حزينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: خلفتموني means you succeeded me in my place and acted as my deputies.
rows.anchor: قمتم مقامى وكنتم خلفائى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke may address the calf worshippers, the Samaritan and his followers, or Aaron and the believers with him; اخلفني in 7:142 supports the latter possibility.
rows.anchor: والخكطاب لبعدة العجل من السامرى وأشياعه أو لهرون ونم معه من المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blame is for worshipping the calf in place of God, or for failing to stop worship of anything besides God; the omitted object of blame is their bad succession.
rows.anchor: بئسما خلفتمونى حيث عبدتم العجل مكان عبادة الله أو حيث لم تكفوا عن عبادة غير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: من بعدي can mean after witnessing Moses' monotheism and rejection of partners, or after he had kept Israel devoted to monotheism; they had previously asked for a god like other people's gods (7:138).
rows.anchor: من بعد ما رأيتم منى من توحيد الله ونفى الشركاء عنه أو من بعد ما كنت احمل بنى إسرائيل على التوحيد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أعجلتم means “did you hasten?” by worshipping the calf; أمر ربكم is God's appointment to give the Torah after forty nights, and haste is seeking something before its time.
rows.anchor: وهو ايتانى لكم بالتوارة بعد أربعين ليلة وأصل العجلة طلب الشئ قبل حينه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation takes عجلتم to mean “did you abandon?”
rows.anchor: وقيل عجلتم بمعنى تركتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses threw the tablets in anger for God's sake; his naturally intense anger contrasts with Aaron's gentler disposition, which made Aaron more beloved to Israel. They broke: six sevenths were removed and one seventh remained, the removed portion containing detailed knowledge and the remainder guidance and mercy.
rows.anchor: ضجرا عند استماعه حديث العجل غضبا لله كان فى نفسه شجديد الغضب وكان هرون أبين منه جانبا ولذلك كان أحب إلى بنى إسرائيل من موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He took Aaron by the hair on his head and dragged him in anger because Aaron did not stop the calf worship, rebuking him.
rows.anchor: بشعر رأسه غضبا عليه حيث لم يمنعهم عن عبادة العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: ابن أم is a compound; Hamza, Ali, and the Shami reader pronounce the م with kasra because the original ي was deleted and its kasra retained. Although Aaron shared both parents, the mother is named because she believed and her mention invites compassion.
rows.anchor: وشامى لأن أصله امى فحذف الياء اجتزاء عنها بالكسرة وكان ابن أمه وأبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Aaron says he tried his utmost through admonition and warning, but the people overpowered him and nearly killed him.
rows.anchor: أى إنى لم آل جهدا فى كفهم بالوعظ والإنذار ولكنهم استضعفونى وهموا بقتلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The enemies are the calf worshippers; Moses should not do what they wish by humiliating or harming Aaron, or treat him as one of the wrongdoers by sharing his anger with them.
rows.anchor: أى لا تفعل بى ما هو أمنيتهم من الاستهاة بى والإساءة إلى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once Moses understood Aaron's excuse, he prayed for both to appease his brother and prevent the enemies' gloating; he sought forgiveness for his own lapse toward Aaron and for Aaron if he failed in his stewardship.
rows.anchor: ليرضى أخاه وينفى الشماتة عنه باشراكه معه فى الدعاء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's mercy here means protection in this world and Paradise in the next.
rows.anchor: عصمتك فى الدنيا وجنتك فى الارخرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrath they incur is God's order that they kill themselves as repentance.
rows.anchor: هو ما أمروا به من قتل أنفهسم توبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their worldly humiliation means either expulsion from their homes, since exile bends the necks, or the imposition of jizya.
rows.anchor: خروجها من ديارهم فالغربة تذل الأعناق أو ضرب الجزية عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The greatest fabrication is the Samaritan's claim that the calf was the god of Israel and of Moses.
rows.anchor: ولا فرية أعظم من قول السامرى هذا إلهكم و إله موسى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The evil deeds include disbelief and sins; repentance means returning to God, and faith means making belief sincere.
rows.anchor: ﴿ والذين عملوا السيئات ﴾ من الكفر والمعاصى ﴿ ثم تابوا ﴾ رجعوا إلى الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: من بعدها can refer to the sins or to repentance.
rows.anchor: أى السيآت أو التوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: غفور means concealing and erasing their former deeds; رحيم means granting them Paradise.
rows.anchor: ﴿ غفور ﴾ لستور علهم محاء لما كان منهم ﴿ رحيم ﴾ منعم عليهم بالجنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clause إن ربك with its subject and predicate functions as the predicate of والذين; this general rule includes calf worshippers and others.
rows.anchor: و إن مع اسمها وخبرها خبر والذين وهذا حكم عام يدخل تحته متخذوالعجل وغيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The pairing stresses immense forgiveness after immense sins: however great sins become, God's pardon is greater, and mercy is emphasized after the threat.
rows.anchor: ثم أردفها بعظم رحمته ليعلم أن الذنوب و أن عظمت فعفوه أعظم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because anger was so intense it seemed to silence Moses, the verse describes it as having fallen silent.
rows.anchor: ولما كان الغضب لشدته كأنه هو الآمن لموسى بما فعل قيل

rows.speaker: الزجاج
rows.claim: Al-Zajjaj explains سكت as “subsided”; this wording was also recited.
rows.anchor: وقال الزجاج معناه سكن وقرئ به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses took back the tablets he had thrown; في نسختها means what was transcribed or written from them, with نسخَة on a pattern that can denote a passive object, like خطبة.
rows.anchor: وفيما نسخ منها أى كتب فعلة بمعنى مفعول كالخطبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lām in للذين is used because the object precedes and the verb's governing force is weak with this construction.
rows.anchor: دخلت اللام لتقدم المفعول وضعف عمل الفعل فيه باعتباره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: اختار قومه means “selected from his people”: the preposition من is omitted and the verb made transitive.
rows.anchor: أى من قومه فحذف الجار وأوصل الفعل

rows.speaker: قيل
rows.claim: An account says Moses chose six men from each of twelve tribes, totaling seventy-two, then two volunteered to stay behind; Kaleb and Joshua remained.
rows.anchor: ﴿ سبعين رجلا ﴾ قيل اختار من اثنى عشر سبطا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The appointed time was for their apology concerning their worship of the calf.
rows.anchor: ﴿ لميقاتنا ﴾ لاعتذارهم معن عبادة العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The الرجفة was a severe earthquake.
rows.anchor: الزلزلة الشديدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses says God could have destroyed the group earlier for calf worship, and him too for killing the Egyptian.
rows.anchor: قبل ﴾ بما كان منهم من عبادة العجل ﴿ وإياي ﴾ لقتلى القبطى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The “foolish ones” are the ignorant calf worshippers; the prayer asks whether all should be destroyed because of their act.
rows.anchor: عقوبة بما فعل الجهال منا وهم أصحاب العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trial is the event God had told Moses about when saying He had tested the people after him (20:85), or it is God's testing servants with whatever He wills, by good and evil (21:35).
rows.anchor: ابتلاؤك وهو راجع إلى قوله إنا قد فتنا قومك من بعدك فقال موسى هى تلك الفتنة التى أخبرتنى بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God leads astray those He knows will choose error and guides those He knows will choose guidance.
rows.anchor: من علمت منهم اختيار الضلالة ﴿ وتهدي ﴾ بها ﴿ من تشاء ﴾ من علمت منهم اختيار الهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses calls God their protector and the one who manages their affairs, asking Him for forgiveness and mercy as the best of forgivers.
rows.anchor: مولانا القائم بأمورنا ﴿ فاغفر لنا وارحمنا وأنت خير الغافرين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: واكتب لنا means establish, confirm, and allot for us.
rows.anchor: وأثبت لنا واقسم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worldly good means safety, a wholesome life, and success in obedience; hereafter it means Paradise.
rows.anchor: عافية وحياة طيبة وتوفيقا فى الطاعة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: هدنا إليك means we repented and returned to You; هاد means “he repented,” and الهُد جمع هائد means penitents.
rows.anchor: تبنا اليك وهاد إليه يهود إذا رجع وتاب والهد جمع هائد وهو التائب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's punishment is a divine attribute, inflicted on whomever He wills, meaning He does not pardon that person.
rows.anchor: ﴿ أصيب به من أشاء ﴾ أى لا أعفو عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mercy is an attribute reaching everything; every Muslim and unbeliever receives some effect of it in this world.
rows.anchor: أى من صفة رحمتى أنها واسعة تبلغ كل شئء ما من مسلم ولا كافر إلا وعليه أثر رحمتى فى الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will write this mercy for those who avoid associationism from Muhammad's community, pay obligatory alms, and believe in all revealed books, denying none.
rows.anchor: الشرك من أمة محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening إذ means “remember when”; من ظهورهم is an apposition to بني آدم, meaning from the backs of Adam's descendants, and the offspring are extracted from their fathers' loins.
rows.anchor: ومعنى أخذ ذرياتهم من ظهورهم إخراجهم من أصلاب آبائهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The testimony is illustrative: God set evidence of His lordship and unity before them, and their implanted rational faculties witnessed it by distinguishing guidance from error, as though He had asked and they acknowledged His unity.
rows.anchor: هذا من بابا التمثيل ومعنى ذلك أنه نصب لهم الأدلة على ربوبيته ووحدانيته وشهدت بها عقولهم التى ركبها فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The purpose is to prevent them from claiming on Judgment Day that they were unaware, since the evidence and their reason had alerted them.
rows.anchor: كراهة أن يقولوا يوم القيامة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: إنا كنا عن هذا غافلين means they might claim they had not been alerted to it.
rows.anchor: لم تنبه عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: أو تقولوا elliptically means “or lest you say”: our fathers associated partners before us, and we merely followed them as later descendants.
rows.anchor: ﴿ أو تقولوا ﴾ أو كراهة أن يقولوا ﴿ إنما أشرك آباؤنا من قبل وكنا ذرية من بعدهم ﴾ فاقتدينا بهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They have no excuse to follow their fathers because evidence of unity was established and they were alerted to it; their fathers likewise had no excuse.
rows.anchor: وما نبهوا عليه قائم معهم فلا غزر لهم فى الاعراض عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ancestors' false practice made the descendants associate partners, because it established the pattern they followed as tradition.
rows.anchor: أى كانوا السبب فى شركنا لتأسهسهم فى الشرك وتركه سنة لنا
